description: Inspect current, stale and conflicting learning hypotheses, including the statements withheld from context. Retract an explicitly rejected finding by id; only the cloud author may retract it, and the retraction applies to the whole workspace. To correct one, use pathrule_record_learning with replaces_id and newly verified sources. Retractions are durable and cannot be undone by an old offline retry. This never promotes a hypothesis to a rule.
name: pathrule_review_learning
title: Review Project Learning
